Metadata.title: Oustians
Metadata.description: The private student app for Obour University for Science and Technology. Meet people, share moments, plan meetups and chat — in Arabic and English.

Common.inProgress: We're building this screen right now — it ships in an upcoming update.

Search.label: Search
Search.emptyBody: Search Oustians by full name or username to visit a profile or start a conversation.
Search.noResultsBody: Check the spelling or try a shorter version of the name.

Composer.title: Create post
Composer.hint: Visible to every approved OUST student.

Feed.title: Feed
Feed.emptyBody: Be the first to share something with campus.

Rail.suggestionsBody: Connect with students from your faculty and year.
Rail.campusBody: The private app for Obour University for Science and Technology students — invite codes and manual approval only.
Rail.aboutBody: Every account is reviewed by hand, so your feed stays full of real OUST students.

ProfileCard.fallbackHeadline: Add your faculty, year and photo

Auth.campusNote: Oustians is for OUST students only. Every account is approved by hand.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with the email you registered.

signup.title: Join Oustians
signup.subtitle: You need an invite code from the university.
signup.inviteHint: We check the code as soon as you leave this field.
signup.usernameHint: 3-24 characters: a-z, 0-9 and underscore — no dots, dashes or spaces. This is how people find you.
signup.approvalNote: An admin reviews your account before the feed opens — the waiting screen comes next.

pending.title: Almost there
pending.body: Thanks {name} — your account is waiting for an admin to approve it. This page re-checks on its own.

rejected.title: Account not approved
rejected.body: An admin reviewed your request and did not approve it. Reply to your invite or contact the team.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Access to Oustians is switched off for this account.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.email_in_use: That email already has an account.
errors.invite_code_invalid: This invite code is not recognised.
errors.invite_code_exhausted: This invite code has been used the maximum number of times.
errors.username_taken: That username is taken — try another one.
errors.username_invalid: Usernames are 3-24 characters: a-z, 0-9 and underscore.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Open the confirmation email before signing in.
errors.not_authorised: You do not have access to that.
errors.profile_update_failed: We could not save your profile. Please try again.
errors.avatar_upload_failed: The photo could not be uploaded. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP under 5 MB.
errors.invite_create_failed: The invite code could not be created.
errors.approval_failed: The decision could not be saved.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

success.confirm_email: Check your inbox — we sent a confirmation link to finish creating your account.

fields.email: Enter a valid email address, such as name@gmail.com.
fields.username: 3-24 characters: a-z, 0-9 and underscore — no dots, dashes or spaces.

Profile.usernameLocked: Your handle is permanent for now — ask an admin if it must change.
Profile.languageHint: Used for emails and for the interface after sign-in.
Profile.privacyHint: Only admins can see your bio, faculty and year. Your name, photo and username stay visible so classmates can find you and message you.
Profile.privateNotice: This profile is private — only admins can see these details.
Profile.postsSoonBody: The feed arrives in the next milestone — then your photos, polls and events show up on this page.

avatar.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. Stored privately in Supabase Storage.
avatar.tooLarge: That image is larger than 5 MB.
avatar.failed: The photo could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.not_authorised: You do not have access to that.
errors.avatar_upload_failed: The photo could not be uploaded. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP under 5 MB.

Admin.title: Admin tools
Admin.queueBody: Approve the students you recognise from campus. Rejecting asks for a reason the member will see.
Admin.queueEmpty: Nothing to review — the queue is empty.
Admin.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. I could not match you with a student record
Admin.invitesBody: Codes are single-use unless you allow more. Switch one off to stop it immediately.
Admin.codesEmpty: No codes yet — create the first one above.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.appearanceHint: Light, dark or follow your device.
Settings.privacyHint: Hide your bio, faculty and year from other members.
Settings.adminHint: Approve members and manage invite codes.

Chat.emptyBody: Open a classmate's profile and tap Message to start chatting.
Chat.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}

errors.too_long: Messages can be up to 2000 characters
errors.send_failed: Couldn't send your message — please try again
errors.start_failed: Couldn't open the conversation — please try again

Post.commentTooLong: Comments can be up to 1000 characters

Notifications.description: Likes and comments on your posts.
